rules.title: No Racism
rules.summary: Racist language, conduct, imagery, or targeted behavior is prohibited.

rules.title: No Sexist Behavior
rules.summary: Sexist, misogynistic, or gender-based harassment is prohibited.

rules.title: Treat Other Players With Respect
rules.summary: Players are expected to interact with others respectfully.

rules.title: No Bullying
rules.summary: Repeated or coordinated bullying of another player is prohibited.

rules.title: No Intentional Team Killing
rules.summary: Deliberate team killing or repeated intentional team damage is prohibited.

rules.title: Do Not Intentionally Impact Server Performance
rules.summary: Players may not knowingly attempt to degrade, overload, crash, or destabilize the server.

rules.title: Do Not Disclose Other Players' Private Information
rules.summary: Players may not disclose, threaten to disclose, or solicit another person's private identifying information.

rules.title: No Cheating or Unfair-Advantage Software
rules.summary: External software, cheats, unauthorized modifications, or automation used for an unfair gameplay advantage are prohibited.

rules.title: No Gore or Sexually Explicit Material
rules.summary: Graphic real-world gore and sexually explicit material may not be posted or displayed through JTWP servers.

rules.title: No Game-Mode Manipulation for Unfair Advantage
rules.summary: Players may not intentionally manipulate game-mode systems, bugs, or unintended mechanics for an unfair advantage.

rules.title: Do Not Threaten Other Players
rules.summary: Credible or targeted threats of serious harm are prohibited.

rules.title: Do Not Deliberately Stop Other Players From Enjoying the Server
rules.summary: Deliberately and repeatedly interfering with other players' reasonable use or enjoyment of the server is prohibited.

rules.title: No Spam or Deliberate Annoyance
rules.summary: Repeated spam or deliberate communication disruption is prohibited.

rules.title: No Slurs or Other Hate Speech
rules.summary: Slurs and hate speech targeting people based on identity or perceived identity are prohibited.

fallback.label: Other / No Existing Rule
fallback.description: Select this when the behavior warrants moderation but no current rule adequately covers it. The case remains valid and is flagged for rules review.
